blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas secured a quarterfinals berth in the women’s basketball 5-on-5 event of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after defeating Hong Kong, 90-73, on Sunday. Stef Berberabe scored 21 points while Afril Bernardino produced 17 points, 11 rebounds, six assists and two steals as Gilas stayed unbeaten in Group B with a 2-0 record.
